Privacy Notice

This app requires access to SMS notifications only to provide its core functionality. Here's what you need to know:

 • We only access notifications from your default SMS app
 • All SMS data is encrypted using Android KeyStore
 • You can revoke access at any time in Settings
 • We do not access any other app notifications
 • All data processing happens locally on your device
 • No data is shared with third parties
 • The app includes security features to protect your privacy

 By continuing, you agree to grant notification access permission for SMS only.
